q: How much of Durgapur's secondary steel energy goes into DRI, and what does CBAM ask of those units?
title: Durgapur DRI units: energy and CBAM
short: Over 77%. TERI's 2023 study puts the belt's secondary steel units, around 100 of them, at 2.18 Mtoe a year, of which DRI kilns use 1.68 Mtoe and emit 5.82 of the cluster's 9.66 Mt CO2. For CBAM, sponge iron counts direct emissions only: kiln coal by mass balance, not the power bill.
audience: Sponge iron, melt shop and rerolling units in Angadpur, Andal, Bamunara, Jamuria and Raniganj around Durgapur

ul: DRI: 1.68 Mtoe and 5.82 Mt CO2 a year.
Steel melting in induction furnaces: 0.20 Mtoe, all electricity, and 1.80 Mt CO2.
Ferro alloys: 0.20 Mtoe and 1.41 Mt. Rerolling mills: 0.07 Mtoe and 0.49 Mt.
Wire drawing and foundries: 0.02 Mtoe each, 0.06 and 0.08 Mt.
Thermal energy 1.78 Mtoe (82%), electricity 0.40 Mtoe (18%). Durgapur Steel Plant itself is not included.

sections.h: Why power matters less for CBAM than for the cluster total
p: Electricity is 18% of the belt's energy, and the melt shops, which run entirely on it, account for 1.80 Mt CO2 on their own. CBAM leaves electricity out for iron and steel goods. A billet's CBAM figure is built mainly from the sponge iron and other inputs charged into the furnace, at their own figures, so a melt shop's EU buyers end up depending on the DRI kiln upstream. Buyers' product footprints and BRSR requests, on the other hand, count the power in full.

sections.h: What a DRI unit needs ready for CBAM
ol: Coal in, by weighbridge, with lab carbon content for each lot or a sampling plan.
Iron ore lumps or pellets in. Pellets are a precursor with their own figure.
Char or dolochar out, weighed, with its carbon content.
Sponge iron out, weighed, with its carbon content.
A verifier accredited for activity group V when your EU buyers ask for verified figures.

ul: DRI kilns: waste heat recovery for power, better coal combustion, partly replacing coal with gas, pellets instead of lump ore.
Rerolling mills: continuous casting in place of a reheating furnace, PLC automation, furnace lining and recuperator care.
Wire units: induction heating for annealing and zinc baths instead of furnace oil.

example.title: Worked example: one month's mass balance at a 100 tpd kiln
lines: Coal in: 3,000 t x 45% carbon = 1,350 t of carbon
Dolochar out: 750 t x 25% carbon = 187.5 t of carbon
Sponge iron out: 3,000 t x 0.2% carbon = 6 t of carbon
Carbon emitted: 1,350 minus 187.5 minus 6 = 1,156.5 t; x 44/12 = 4,240.5 t CO2
Per tonne of sponge iron: 4,240.5 / 3,000 = about 1.41 t CO2, plus any pellets at their own figure; the kiln's power adds nothing for CBAM
example.note: Example tonnages and carbon contents; use your own weighbridge records and lab results. Dolochar later burnt in a boiler is counted as fuel where it is burnt.
